pli-tv-bi-vb-np4:1.1: Tena samayena buddho bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np4:1.2: tena kho pana samayena Thullanandā bhikkhunī gilānā hoti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np4:1.3: atha kho aññataro upāsako yena Thullanandā bhikkhunī ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā Thullanandaṃ bhikkhuniṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-bi-vb-np4:1.4: kin te ayye aphāsu, kiṃ āhariyatū 'ti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np4:1.6: atha kho so upāsako aññatarassa āpaṇikassa gharā kahāpaṇassa sappiṃ āharitvā Thullanandāya bhikkhuniyā adāsi.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np4:1.10: atha kho so upāsako yena so āpaṇiko ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā taṃ āpaṇikaṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-bi-vb-np4:1.11: na kir' ayyo ayyāya sappinā attho, telena attho.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np4:1.12: handa te sappiṃ, telaṃ me dehīti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np4:1.13: sace mayaṃ ayyo vikkītaṃ bhaṇḍaṃ puna āharissāma, kadā amhākaṃ bhaṇḍaṃ vikkāyissati.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np4:1.14: sappissa kayena sappi haṭaṃ, telassa kayaṃ āhara, telaṃ harissasīti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np4:1.15: atha kho so upāsako ujjhāyati khīyati vipāceti:
pli-tv-bi-vb-np4:1.16: kathaṃ hi nāma ayyā Thullanandā aññaṃ viññāpetvā aññaṃ viññāpessatīti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np4:1.17: assosuṃ kho bhikkhuniyo tassa upāsakassa . . . vipācentassa.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np4:1.19: atha kho tā bhikkhuniyo bhikkhūnaṃ . . . ārocesuṃ.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np4:1.21: saccaṃ kira bhikkhave Thullanandā bhikkhunī aññaṃ viññāpetvā aññam viññāpesīti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np4:1.24: hi nāma bhikkhave Thullanandā bhikkhunī . . . viññāpessati.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np4:1.27.1: yā pana bhikkhunī aññaṃ viññāpetvā aññaṃ viññāpeyya, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyan ti. ||1||
pli-tv-bi-vb-np4:2.1.8: taṃ ṭhapetvā aññaṃ viññāpeti, payoge dukkaṭaṃ,
pli-tv-bi-vb-np4:2.1.10: nissajjitabbaṃ saṃghassa vā gaṇassa vā ekabhikkhuniyā vā.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np4:2.1.13: idaṃ me ayye aññaṃ viññāpetvā aññaṃ viññāpitaṃ nissaggiyaṃ, imāhaṃ saṃghassa nissajjāmīti --pa--
pli-tv-bi-vb-np4:2.2.1: aññe aññasaññā aññaṃ viññāpeti, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np4:2.2.4: anaññe aññasaññā anaññaṃ viññāpeti, āpatti dukkaṭassa.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np4:2.2.5: anaññe vematikā anaññaṃ viññāpeti, āpatti dukkaṭassa.
